What comes up in Toongabbie

3 conditions, and each one is handled differently

Every site is scoped on the day. This sets out the typical case here rather than anything about a given address.

Pool removal and backfill

Toongabbie rear yards frequently have a pool in them, and taking one out properly is a different job from filling it.

How it is handled
Shell broken out and removed, void backfilled with material suitable for whatever is going on top, then compacted in layers rather than tipped and covered.
What does it
Excavator with a hammer, then clean fill brought in and compacted.

Shed and garage with fibro sheeting

Old outbuildings on pre 1990 Toongabbie blocks are among the most likely places to find cement sheet roofing and wall panels.

How it is handled
Condition assessed before anything is touched, because weathered sheeting may have to be handled as friable rather than bonded.
What does it
Licensed asbestos removalists, with the licence class set by the condition.

Sheds, garages, pools and outbuildings

Partial demolition, and frequently several structures in one scope with a different waste stream against each.

How it is handled
Taken down separately so the streams stay apart. A pool shell is broken out and removed, then the void is backfilled with suitable material and compacted in layers.
What does it
Mini or midi excavator, a hammer for the pool shell, and tippers rather than a truck and dog on the smaller volumes.

Toongabbie

What shapes the work on these blocks

  • Large rear yards Post-war blocks with room behind the house, which usually means more than one structure to remove.
  • Pools in the scope Shell broken out, void backfilled with suitable material and compacted in layers rather than simply filled.
  • Good machine access on most blocks Which keeps the programme short and the plant appropriate.
  • Pre 1990 stock With fibro common in sheds and outbuildings as well as the house.

Toongabbie blocks are generally generous enough to work on properly, with room to stockpile briefly and load trucks rather than carting as material falls. Where a pool is coming out, the rubble and the backfill are two separate movements and both are planned into the programme.

Toongabbie questions

What people ask before we start

Do you fill the pool void or take it right out?
Both are done. The shell is broken out and removed, then the void is backfilled with material suitable for whatever is going on top, placed and compacted in layers. Simply pushing the shell in and covering it causes problems later.
Is there asbestos in an old backyard shed?
Often. Fibro sheeting and roofing on sheds and outbuildings is extremely common on pre 1990 blocks, and it is sampled and handled the same way as the house.
Do you charge travel to come out to Western Sydney?
No. Western Sydney is one of the two areas we are in most weeks, so there is no travel loading on work here and a site visit is usually easy to arrange.
Who signs off that the asbestos is gone?
An independent licensed assessor, not the removalist and not us. Max holds demolition licence AD214737, the removal is carried out by licensed asbestos removalists, and the clearance is arranged as part of the same job.
